spatial-concepts-decay-site.alt: Left: a graph of visits a week against distance from a store, a curve that falls steeply and then levels off: fewer visits come from far away. This is distance decay. Right: two boxes. Site is the place itself, such as high ground, a river bend, fresh water or flat land. Situation is its links to other places, such as being on a trade route, near a port or between two cities.
